sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Azaz Ahmad Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.
Heard Sri Azaz Ahmad, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Rajeev Kr. Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This application has been filed to quash the entire proceeding of Case No. 3258 of 2023, arising out of case crime No. 48 of 2023, u/s 498A, 323, 504 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Vijay Nagar, District Ghaziabad.

3. Contention of learned counsel for the applicants is that the dispute between the parties is matrimonial in nature and both the parties have settled their dispute amicably and entered into compromise dated 3.10.2024.
It is further submitted that the said compromise has already been filed before the court below.
4. Learned AGA states that the impugned proceeding cannot be quashed until the aforesaid compromise is verified.

5. In view of the above, the court below is directed to verify the said compromise after summoning the parties within a period of two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and after Javed @ Imran And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12162230/
1 verification, the court below will dispose of the impugned proceeding in accordance with law.

entities.text: Javed @ Imran And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. For a period of two months or till verification of compromise, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
7. However, the parties are at liberty to file a fresh application under Section 528 BNSS to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified copy of compromise, if need arises.
8. With the aforesaid direction, the present application is disposed of.
